question: In a certain code language, ‘NODUS’ is written as ‘KJUDF’ and ‘PILLOW’ is written as ‘IPMMJB’. How will ‘NAVEL’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06c763f2e72003075eaee6af4738c1926ab7ccdc20924dbd0d1d31468dc27e74.png] 

The logic followed here:

‘NODUS’ is written as ‘KJUDF’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7678a7e4175ae1947bbd385d30001c4ae9dfab991f2b0575806d2014ad331f49.png] 

‘KJUDF’ and ‘PILLOW’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4a30cbdbe75d9660517f2fe46d76a7350db4bbfc5dd5fa0598c6ad1e8b981f7.png] 

Similarly, ‘**NAVEL**’ will be written:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a22ec93b8864dd285b9b8e5600f6fe16787ff03d996b172f7fc5c02f634f636.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
